top_signal.title: Where can we find overseas sales partners for our insulated bottle manufacturing business?
top_signal.summary: We’re looking for people overseas who might be interested in helping us find new customers on a part-time basis. (Insulated water bottle and tumbler based in China.)   We’d like to connect with independent sales reps or people who have experience selling to local retailers, drinkware brands, wholesalers, or corporate gift companies.   Our team would handle manufacturing and export coordination. The partner’s role would be to introduce potential buyers, understand what they need, and help with customer communication.   We’re open to sharing the profits from orders you help bring in. The percentage, how profit is calculated, and when payments are made would be discussed and agreed on before we start working together.    Has anyone here worked with a manufacturer under a similar arrangement? Where would you suggest looking for reliable partners, and what would make this kind of partnership worth considering?        submitted by     /u/PuzzleheadedKick5916       [link]       [comments]
